title.narrative: Strengthening Kenya's Peacebuilding Architecture for Conflict Prevention in the Lead up to the 2027 General Elections

description.narrative: This project will support the deployment of an international Peace and Development Advisor to serve the full UNCT and coordinate UN support to the national peace infrastructure, linking peacebuilding and social cohesion to broader development goals. The PDA will strengthen strategic partnerships with key national stakeholders, regional and international actors and development partners on issues related to Sustaining Peace and the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. In the lead up to the 2027 general elections, the PDA will provide risk-informed analysis to the RC and the broader UNCT and work with national stakeholders to build, strengthen, and sustain nationally owned efforts to prevent violent conflict. The project will also support catalytic activities to enhance awareness of the peacebuilding architecture review report and the national agenda for peace, strengthen institutional capacities to anticipate and respond to risks, including through updating and integrating the national early warning system, hotspot mapping, horizon scanning and futures thinking, mediation support and civil society engagement. The project will complement projects on elections, peacebuilding, youth engagement and LNOB inclusion.
